_note: Held-out labeled set for symptom triage. Frozen 2026-10-09 before triage changes. label: urgent (needs emergency services now) | watch (tell family, consider doctor) | routine. Labels follow common public first-aid guidance (FAST stroke signs, chest pain, breathing, falls with injury/inability to get up, hypoglycaemia symptoms in a person on diabetes medicine); they are not clinical advice.
